name: review-tools
description: Render a change or a subsystem as one self-contained HTML page, no server: `explain` gives an IDE-style view of a code diff, a GitHub issue plus everything linked to it, or docs; `walkthrough` gives a diagram-first, ordered-step presentation — how something works, a tech-debt or performance analysis, recommendations; `tech-debt` runs a repo-wide structural-debt audit and files GitHub issues for what the owner confirms. Standalone; also wired into spec-flow's owner seams when both plugins are installed.
